user_query: My family and I are huge fans of Formula 1 racing. We want to attend a live race and make some bets on the drivers and teams. Can you provide me with the current standings of the teams and drivers in the ongoing season? Also, give me the details of the football matches happening today and their live odds.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the current standings of drivers and teams in the ongoing Formula 1 season.
Find upcoming or ongoing Formula 1 races and their locations.
Provide details of live football matches happening today, including teams, match times, and live odds.
Aggregate and present betting options and odds for the football matches.
